title: Union press breakfast on rising prices and wage revision in Cotonou
location: Cotonou, Benin; Bourse du Travail appears only in the S005 search excerpt
scope: Union press event in Cotonou; broader public participation and geographic reach unknown.
organizer: Representatives of Beninese union centres/confederations; S001 names CSA-Bénin, UNSTB and CGTB. S005 search-only excerpt says six centres/confederations.
participants_original: Unknown; neither opened S001 nor search-only S005 reports an attendee count.
threshold_50_evidence: Pending: no attendance estimate or evidence that the press breakfast was open to the general public; the available reports call it a press event/conference. The ≥50 public-gathering threshold is not established.

start_date.summary: S001 body reports the union press breakfast on Friday 2022-01-28 in Cotonou; S005 search result is dated 2022-01-29 and also places the press conference on 2022-01-28.

location.summary: S001 body places the press breakfast in Cotonou; the Bourse du Travail venue appears only in S005 search-result text and remains unverified from its unread body.

scope.summary: The sources describe a union press event. They do not show it was open to the public or identify participation beyond union representatives and press.

organizer.summary: S001 names speakers from CSA-Bénin, UNSTB and CGTB. S005 search-result text refers to six union centres/confederations; that detail is not body-verified.

demands.summary: S001 reports calls for government salary negotiations and wage revaluation, measures to control prices, and review of the tax code and related wage policy.

participants_original.summary: Attendance is not reported in either the opened Banouto account or the La Nouvelle Tribune search excerpt.

participants_min.summary: No published numeric or qualitative attendance estimate allows a lower bound.

participants_max.summary: No published numeric or qualitative attendance estimate allows an upper bound.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither source gives an attendance figure or establishes open public access; the reported press event does not establish a ≥50 public protest gathering.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific protester violence is reported; absence is not coded, so value remains unknown.

state_response.summary: The article reports demands but no event-specific state response; each response field remains unknown rather than inferred from silence.

end_date.summary: Neither source reports an ending time or date; end date remains unknown.

notes: S001 describes a union press breakfast where wage, price and tax demands were stated; it does not establish a public protest meeting or a crowd. S005 is search-only and may be a separate report of the same press event. Do not treat the later February meetings as continuation of this press event.
open_questions: Was the press event open to the public or limited to invited press and union representatives?
Was there a distinct public demonstration or mass meeting on 2022-01-28?
What was the end time and was there any event-specific state response?
Is S005 independent reporting or a republication/related story?
